The plate is square, about 21 cm across in the image (roughly 465 px wide), so about 22 px per cm. I'm treating it as a side plate.

The bread is about 170 px by 215 px, which is roughly 7.5 by 9.5 cm. It looks like half a bagel or a thick slice, about 1.5 cm high. That gives roughly 7 × 9 × 1.5 × 0.5 of crumb density, about 35 g, and I'm rounding up to 40 g.

The cream cheese covers an area of about 140 px by 190 px, which is 6 by 8.5 cm. Spread at about 0.5 cm thick over roughly 40 cm², that comes to about 20 cm³, or about 20 g. A thin spread makes 20 g reasonable.
